rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern when there is none of something left, including supplies that have run out.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 mou5 saai3 din6 ci4 laa3

rows.jyutping: A go3 jap6 min6 dak1 B go3
rows.note: Use this counting pattern for saying that B items are among a total of A.

example.english: Three out of ten apples are ripe.
example.traditional: 十個蘋果入面得三個熟咗。
example.jyutping: sap6 go3 ping4 gwo2 jap6 min6 dak1 saam1 go3 suk6 zo2

rows.note: Use this when someone or something moves from inside a place to outside it.

example.english: Ming came out of the room.
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 jau4 gaan1 fong2 ceot1 lai4 laa3
